# Agentic Learning OS (`agentic-learning-os` v3.0.0)

> Learn Anything. Build Everything. Master More.
> Developer & Maintainer: Md. Aktaruzzaman Emon (https://github.com/emon404x)
> Repository: https://github.com/emon404x/agentic-learning-os
> Category: Agentic AI / Education / Multi-Agent Systems

## Overview
Agentic Learning OS is a multi-agent AI Learning Operating System built for Google Antigravity Agent Skills (`.agents/skills/`) and standalone Python/CLI orchestration (`scripts/alos.py`).

## Core Execution Loops
- Pedagogical Loop: `RESEARCH -> UNDERSTAND -> PLAN -> LEARN -> PRACTICE -> BUILD -> TEST -> REVIEW -> MASTER`
- Agentic Loop (`LearningOrchestrator`): `UNDERSTAND -> PLAN -> SELECT_AGENTS -> SELECT_TOOLS -> EXECUTE -> OBSERVE -> VERIFY -> REFLECT -> SAVE_PROGRESS -> RESPOND`

## Key Entry Points
- Workspace Rules: `.agents/AGENTS.md`
- Master Orchestrator Skill: `.agents/skills/learn-anything/SKILL.md`
- Python Orchestrator: `learning_engine/src/learning_engine/agents/orchestrator.py`
- 10 Specialized Agents: `learning_engine/src/learning_engine/agents/specialists.py`
- 5-Tier Autonomy & Permissions: `learning_engine/src/learning_engine/agents/permissions.py`
- Modular Tool Registry: `learning_engine/src/learning_engine/tools/registry.py`
- MCP & Antigravity SDK Adapters: `learning_engine/src/learning_engine/mcp/adapters.py`
- Unified CLI: `scripts/alos.py` (and `scripts/stardi.py`)
